decisions.reason: This handle design has had no visible presence since 2018 in a portfolio crowded with similar handle options, and sibling handle lines were already withdrawn, so the evidence points to an option whose value is not being realized and whose resources are better used elsewhere.

Like C, this design variant shows no sign of traction after several years among many substitute handle options, so the option is best abandoned and its resources moved to the established business or new development.

The electronic access system remains a strategic growth option toward digital building organization, and its uncertain but potentially large upside justifies keeping it open despite limited recent visibility.
